name: Questions to Ask About ADA Parking When Repaving in LA County

mainEntity.name: What should I ask a Los Angeles County paving contractor about ADA parking and accessibility when repaving a commercial lot?
mainEntity.text: What should I ask a Los Angeles County paving contractor about ADA parking and accessibility when repaving a commercial lot?

acceptedAnswer.text: When repaving a commercial parking lot in Los Angeles County, accessibility should be part of the conversation from the start. Ask your paving contractor how they will address accessible parking spaces, including the quantity, sizes, and locations relative to building entrances. They should understand how slopes, cross slopes, and surface smoothness affect wheelchair users and walkers. Request a proposed layout that indicates accessible spaces, access aisles, paths of travel, curb ramps, and loading zones. Verify that surface slopes are designed to be within acceptable ranges and that water will not pond in accessible areas. Inquire who is responsible for determining whether the striping plan and slopes satisfy current accessibility requirements: your contractor, a designer, or another consultant. Also ask how the contractor will handle phasing so that some accessible parking remains available if the site is open during construction. Clear communication with tenants and customers about temporary parking changes is important. A knowledgeable Los Angeles County paving contractor can coordinate layout, striping, and signage in a way that improves usability and reduces the risk of costly rework due to accessibility concerns.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask your paving contractor how they will maintain or improve ADA accessibility, including the number and location of accessible spaces, slopes, striping, curb ramps, and signage. Request a layout showing slopes and markings before work starts and confirm who is responsible for ensuring the design meets current accessibility standards.
